# Brand Guard baseline report

Corpus `c-c3297e252edc` · detector `01220ce911b6` · replay v1

**How to read this.** Every figure is `rate% [95% Wilson interval] (k/n)`. ⚠ marks strata with fewer than 30 records — their rates are indicative only. There is deliberately no single headline number. Only the *name-based identity stage* is measured; abuse scoring, status and alerting cannot be measured offline.

## Illustrative precision (identity stage only — read the caveat)

> Identity stage ONLY (abuse stage not modelled) and assumption-driven: the corpus has no real prevalence, so these show how little the name alone separates malicious from benign, not what customers will experience.

TPR (identity ≥ 55): 11.3% · FPR vs unrelated: 0.033% · FPR vs popular lookalikes: 32.2%

| Assumed prevalence of malicious among surfaced names | precision vs unrelated | precision vs popular lookalikes |
|---|---|---|
| 1% | 77.4% | 0.4% |
| 0.1% | 25.3% | 0.0% |

## Not measured here

- abuse_score
- suggested_status
- alerting
- reason: needs live DNS, registration age and certificate facts that cannot be reconstructed for historical domains
- Precision/recall of the full pipeline, status and alert behaviour, true detection latency, and any claim about homoglyph or typo-squat phishing (no such positives in the corpus).
